name: @role-orchestrator/scheduler
description: M2-02 three-level concurrency (global/project/profile from strict-parsed policies + profile config), credentialGroup lock (A33: unverified isolation serializes a group at unverifiedCredentialGroupMax=1), and the fair READY queue (priority then wait time with a starvation bound). Quota grants are store transactions with per-key monotonic fencing tokens (migration 004), dispatch is one atomic claim per entry (check quotas -> grants -> execution -> queue DISPATCHED -> outbox), and every dispatch passes the capability gate first (unknown capability ids are rejected, never treated as usable). M4-04 adds the controlled requeue-to-WAITING (guarded by the budget package's retry classification and the A21 three-attempt cap), the held-run scheduling enforcement point (a run held behind an expansion or usage-undetermined hold enqueues and dispatches nothing), and the per-run resource budget consumed inside the dispatch claim transaction.
